result.rationale: In sharing mode, parseRefreshTokenResponse uses minimumTokenResponseSchema (only access_token + a numeric field; zod strips unknown keys by default), and the sync endpoint comment says its response 'should only contain the access token and expiry date'. The Salesforce code then writes key: { ...accessTokenParsed.data, refresh_token }, so instance_url (and signature/scope) are stripped from the stored credential, breaking subsequent jsforce connection construction that relies on the stored instance_url.
